pois.name: Eiffel Tower (Tour Eiffel)
pois.address: Champ de Mars, 5 Avenue Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France
pois.description: Iconic 330m iron lattice tower designed by Gustave Eiffel, offering panoramic views over Paris.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-renowned iconic symbol of Paris
✓ Spectacular panoramic city views from the summit and second floor
pois.tip: Book elevator tickets in advance to bypass long ticket lines, especially around sunset.

pois.name: Louvre Museum (Musée du Louvre)
pois.description: The world's largest art museum, home to masterpieces including the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unmatched historic art collection spanning antiquity to 1848
✓ Iconic glass pyramid entrance by I.M. Pei
pois.tip: Closed on Tuesdays. Enter via the Carrousel du Louvre underground mall to reduce wait times.

pois.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral & Île de la Cité
pois.address: 6 Parvis Notre-Dame - Pl. Jean-Paul II, 75004 Paris, France
pois.description: Masterpiece of French Gothic architecture on Île de la Cité, dating to the 12th century.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Historic heart of medieval Paris on the River Seine
✓ Magnificent Gothic facade, rose windows, and gargoyles
pois.tip: Stroll around the parvis and along the Seine embankments to view the restored spire and flying buttresses.

pois.name: Musée d'Orsay
pois.address: 1 Rue de la Légion d'Honneur, 75007 Paris, France
pois.description: Renowned museum in a Beaux-Arts railway station holding the world's largest collection of Impressionist art.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ World-class collection of Monet, Renoir, Van Gogh, and Cézanne
✓ Architectural grandeur of the 1900 Gare d'Orsay railway hall
pois.tip: Closed on Mondays. Thursday evenings have extended hours until 9:45 PM with lighter crowds.

pois.name: Arc de Triomphe & Champs-Élysées
pois.address: Place Charles de Gaulle, 75008 Paris, France
pois.description: Monumental triumphal arch honoring French military history at the western end of the Champs-Élysées.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ 360-degree panoramic rooftop terrace looking down 12 radiating grand avenues
✓ Tomb of the Unknown Soldier and eternal flame
pois.tip: Use the underground pedestrian passage from the Champs-Élysées; do not try to cross the roundabout traffic.

pois.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica & Montmartre
pois.address: 35 Rue du Chevalier de la Barre, 75018 Paris, France
pois.description: White Romano-Byzantine basilica perched atop the Montmartre butte, the highest point in Paris.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Highest vantage point in Paris overlooking the entire metropolis
✓ Historic bohemian artist quarter, winding cobblestone lanes, and Place du Tertre
pois.tip: Take the Montmartre Funicular using a standard metro ticket if you wish to skip the 222 steps.

provenance.price_source: Free General Entry (Dome ascent optional fee)

pois.name: Sainte-Chapelle
pois.description: 13th-century royal Gothic chapel famous for its 15 soaring stained-glass windows spanning 15 meters in height.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unsurpassed medieval stained glass illuminating the upper chapel with jewel-toned light
✓ Intimate jewel of High Gothic architecture
pois.tip: Visit on a sunny midday for the most breathtaking optical effect through the 1,113 stained glass scenes.

pois.name: Jardin du Luxembourg
pois.address: Rue de Médicis - Rue de Vaugirard, 75006 Paris, France
pois.description: 25-hectare tranquil public park commissioned by Marie de' Medici in 1612, featuring tree-lined promenades and the Medici Fountain.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Quintessential Parisian public garden relaxation
✓ Picturesque Medici Fountain and green metal lounge chairs around the grand basin
pois.tip: Perfect afternoon stop for relaxed walking or reading near the Latin Quarter.

pois.name: Bouillon Chartier Grands Boulevards
pois.address: 7 Rue du Faubourg Montmartre, 75009 Paris, France
pois.description: Legendary 1896 Belle Époque dining hall offering traditional French classics at democratic prices.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic historic Paris bouillon atmosphere with Belle Époque glass ceiling
✓ Waiters scribbling your bill directly on the paper tablecloth
pois.tip: No reservations accepted; arrive by 11:45 AM or after 2:00 PM to avoid long sidewalk queues.

provenance.price_source: A la carte menu (€12-€18 EUR average meal)

pois.name: Café de Flore & Saint-Germain
pois.description: Historic literary café frequented by Sartre, de Beauvoir, and Picasso on Boulevard Saint-Germain.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Parisian sidewalk cafe culture in chic Saint-Germain-des-Prés
✓ Celebrated rich hot chocolate (chocolat chaud) served in a porcelain pitcher
pois.tip: Enjoy an outdoor terrace table for people-watching and soaking up left bank intellectual heritage.
pois.signature_dish: Chocolat Chaud Spécial Flore / Croque Monsieur
